name.value: Surrey Nature Centre at Green Timbers

description.value: The Surrey Nature Centre is a publicly operated interpretive facility nestled alongside Green Timbers Urban Forest, one of Surrey's largest tracts of second-growth forest. Visitors can borrow activity backpacks or fishing rods from the front desk, explore the Birds of Green Timbers exhibit, and browse a library of field guides and nature books. The centre serves as a natural trailhead destination for cyclists exploring the Green Timbers Urban Forest trail network.
